remarks: Make your home in this corner unit offering a bright inviting layout. The generous living area flows into a dedicated dining space, creating an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining. Large windows frame impressive distant views, giving you a stunning backdrop from nearly every angle. The kitchen features abundant cabinetry and ample counter space. Just off the main living area, a private balcony provides enough space for cafe seating and outdoor lounging, making it an enjoyable spot to unwind while taking in the scenery. The primary bedroom, with a walk in closet, easily accommodates a king size bed and additional furniture.. A second bedroom offers flexibility for guests, work, or hobbies. Large full bathroom. Multiple closets throughout the unit provide excellent storage options. Residents enjoy access to a range of community amenities, including a pool, fitness center, basement laundry room, gated entrance with security, and an assigned outdoor parking space. The HOA covers heat, hot water, water, sewer, trash removal, parking, and all shared facilities. Close to shops, dining, and entertainment. Near public transportation-including a nearby bus stop connecting to Metro-North-this home offers exceptional value. Unit being sold as-is.
